# Model: train length L, platform length P = 5L, pole time t, platform time 6t.
# Pole:     v = L / t
# Platform: v = (L + P) / (6t)
# Check whether the consistency condition holds for every L (sampled exactly).

def consistent(L, t):

    v_pole = Fraction(L) / t
    v_plat = Fraction(L + P) / (6 * t)
    return v_pole == v_plat
